title: Warm Sound Translation
sonic_description: Warm, full-bodied sound with softened highs and pleasant midrange emphasis
why: Low-pass filter in mid-range softens harsh highs. Soft attack envelope creates gentle onset. Light detune adds thickness without harshness. Subtle soft-clip adds warmth without obvious distortion.
how_to_apply: Use for pads, basses, and lead sounds where brightness is not desired. Start with filter cutoff at 0.3 and adjust based on source material.
